title: Stone-pelting, lathicharge at Khesari Lal Yadav's show in Bihar's Nalanda; FIR filed

ai.summary: Police registered an FIR after a cultural event in Nalanda, Bihar, was disrupted by stone-pelting and vandalism, with security using lathicharge to control the crowd.

facts.claim: Police registered an FIR against unidentified persons
facts.quote: Police have registered an FIR against unidentified persons and are examining videos to identify those involved.

facts.claim: Stone-pelting and vandalism disrupted the event
facts.quote: A cultural programme featuring Bhojpuri singer and actor Khesari Lal Yadav in Bihar's Nalanda district witnessed chaos after a large crowd reportedly turned unruly, with stone-pelting, a police lathicharge and vandalism disrupting the event.

facts.claim: Security used lathicharge to disperse the crowd
facts.quote: As the situation escalated, security personnel resorted to a lathicharge to disperse the crowd.
